title: Ambient projective-line unit and counit composites
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] with the actual pulled-back coefficients [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the ordinary unbounded internal-module categories $D(Z)$, derived operations [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and tensor and coefficient unit [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. For any scheme $Y$ put $P=\mathbf P^1_Y$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], $W=P\times_Y P$, $q:P\to Y$, projections $p_1,p_2$ and diagonal $\Delta$. Let $L_Z$ be internal coefficient modules on each scheme and let $d$ be a coefficient diagram [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category] giving its specified diagonal map $\delta:(\Delta_*\Lambda_P)[0]\to L_W[2]$ and trace $\tau:Rq_*L_P[2]\to\Lambda_Y[0]$, transported through the diagram's full-unit-normalized identification with the published derived direct image. Fix the specified isomorphism $e:Lp_2^*(L_P[2])\simeq L_W[2]$. Write $T_Z(A)=(A\otimes L_Z[0])[2]$ and use its canonical tensor-shift comparison and twisted projection $\Pi$ [def-sfb-tate-twisted-projection-comparison]. For $M\in D(P)$ for which the canonical self-base-change exchange $b_M:Lq^*Rq_*M\to Rp_{2*}Lp_1^*M$ [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] and $\Pi_{p_2,e,Lp_1^*M}$ are invertible, define $\eta_M:M\to T_P(Lq^*Rq_*M)$ as the canonical section identification $M\simeq Rp_{2*}R\Delta_*M$ [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-composition], followed by direct image of the diagonal tensor isomorphism [def-sfb-internal-diagonal-tensor-comparison], identity tensor the supported-unit identification and $\delta$, and the tensor-shift comparison, then $\Pi^{-1}$ and $T_P(b_M^{-1})$. For $K\in D(Y)$ for which the canonical left-factor projection $K\otimes Rq_*L_P[2]\to Rq_*(Lq^*K\otimes L_P[2])$ [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-composition] is invertible, define $\varepsilon_K:Rq_*T_P(Lq^*K)\to K$ as $Rq_*$ of the inverse tensor-shift comparison, inverse projection, $1_K\otimes\tau$, and the coefficient-unit identification [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-pullback] and right unitor. These are the ambient composites before any localizing restriction; each entire fixed formula uniquely determines its morphism.
